task: DB table and migration graph vs ML pipelines; inventory ML model registry, provider fallbacks, RAG pipeline, OCR, ASR, synthesis v2, and evaluation suites.

db_table_and_migration_graph.service_boundary: Decoupled FastAPI service architecture. API gateway interacts with ML service strictly over HTTP with X-ML-Internal-Key header; services/api never executes direct SQL on ML tables.
db_table_and_migration_graph.orm_declarative_base: clara_ml.rag.store.schema.Base (local to services/ml, no shared Base with services/api)

tables.purpose: Authoritative registry of knowledge sources with trust_tier (1-4), license, robots.txt policy, and fetch metadata.
Source document headers with SHA-256 content_hash for idempotent re-ingestion, title, URL, language, and effective_date.
Hierarchical text chunks with parent_id foreign key, token count, trust_tier, and PostgreSQL tsvector full-text index.
Dense vector embeddings parameterized by RAG_EMBEDDING_DIM (default 3072), model_id discriminator, and ANN index (HNSW/IVFFlat).
Learned-lexical (bge-m3) sparse terms with per-term float weights for hybrid sparse-dense retrieval.
RxNorm and UMLS normalized medical entities (CUI, RXCUI, canonical Vietnamese/English names) with pg_trgm GIN index.
Bipartite link table binding text chunks to recognized entities with span text and confidence score.
Clinical relation edges (drug-interaction, contraindication) powering GraphRAG multi-hop retrieval.
Golden Vietnamese medical Q&A evaluation dataset with qid, questions, gold answers, expected RXCUIs, and required citations.
Per-question evaluation run execution metrics: recall@k, ndcg@k, faithfulness, citation_acc, and latency_ms.

migration_runner.ddl_strategy: Extension-aware, additive-only DDL using CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS semantics. Never drops or alters existing tables.
migration_runner.startup_self_check: clara_ml.rag.store.health.run_startup_self_check validates pgvector extension and 8 required kb_* tables; gracefully degrades to in-memory store if DB is unready, preventing crash on boot.

ml_model_registry.governance_rule: DeepSeek-only baseline with explicit ModelTask contracts. Temperature=0.0 across all clinical and safety tasks. Pro/Flash model profiles.

provider_fallbacks.failover_architecture: Multi-tier resilience in DeepSeekClient and ModelGateway.
provider_fallbacks.base_url_pool_failover: DeepSeekClient parses comma-separated DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL endpoints, cycling through replicas on 5xx errors before tripping the circuit breaker.
provider_fallbacks.circuit_breaker: clara_ml.llm.circuit_breaker.CircuitBreaker tracks failure rates across 3 states (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN) with cooldown retry window.

model_gateway_adapters.deepseek: Primary reasoning and generative adapter for text and clinical tasks.
model_gateway_adapters.unofficial_gemini_gateway: Fast multimodal and vision gateway for extraction and OCR bridging.
model_gateway_adapters.deepseek_audio: ASR transcription adapter routing to Whisper endpoint.

asr_provider_selection.fallback: Configured via SCRIBE_ASR_FALLBACK (options: google_stt_v2_chirp3, phowhisper). Deduplicates identical providers to avoid redundant failure loops.

provider_fallbacks.safety_fallback_invariant: In clinical safety routes (medical_safety_router, lifemap_ask_router), model failure never falls back to an unverified smaller LLM; it deterministically executes hard legal/emergency guards and returns safe fail-closed guidance.

rag_pipeline.architecture: Hybrid multi-stage retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and Cross-Encoder Re-ranking.

retrieval_modes.persistent: HybridRetriever querying PostgreSQL pgvector (dense cosine similarity) and FTS tsvector / bge-m3 sparse terms, fused via RRF.
retrieval_modes.in_memory: InMemoryRetriever using token-overlap and cosine similarity over seed documents (safe offline fallback).

rag_pipeline.reranking: clara_ml.rag.retrieval.reranker.EvidenceReranker applies contextual relevance scoring on candidate chunks.
rag_pipeline.graphrag: clara_ml.rag.graphrag.GraphRagSidecar traverses multi-hop entity relationships (drug interactions, disease associations) from kb_entity_edges.
rag_pipeline.authority_ranking: 4-tier hierarchy (Tier 1: MOH/regulator, Tier 2: clinical guidelines, Tier 3: peer-reviewed literature, Tier 4: general health).
rag_pipeline.fides_tighten_only_contract: tighten_fides_verdict_with_trust ensures low-authority (Tier >= 3) or stale (> 5 years) retrieved evidence can only escalate/tighten borderline 'warn' verdicts to 'fail', never loosen a blocking critical gate.

ocr_service.technology: Multimodal Gemini Vision bridge (Gemini 3.7 Flash Tiered / 3.6 Flash High via router gateway) with Google Cloud Vision fallback.
ocr_service.input_handling: Multipart form file upload or JSON base64 with auto MIME-detection (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP).
ocr_service.output_contract: Extracted prescription/lab text, bounding boxes, and normalized drug entity candidates.

asr_service.contract: OpenAI-compatible multipart audio transcriptions API with voice activity detection (vad_filter=True).

correctness_properties.P2: Scope monotonicity: broader scope => target non-decreasing
correctness_properties.P3: Density monotonicity: more evidence => target non-decreasing
correctness_properties.P4: Broad-query band: broad + high-density deep_beta yields target >= 8000
correctness_properties.P5: No-pad floor: narrow + sparse query yields target < floor, not appendix-padded
correctness_properties.P6: Convergence: expansion stops only on target-met OR round/timeout exhaustion
correctness_properties.P7: Word-count consistency: single shared word counter across pipeline
correctness_properties.P8: Flags-off equivalence: with flag False, behavior is identical to legacy baseline
correctness_properties.P9: Guardrail preservation: never prescribe/diagnose; emergency fast-path intact

specialized_evaluation_programs: glhs_toctou_r2 & glhs_postgres_toctou (state machine race conditions under PostgreSQL serializable)
careguard_external (pharmacopeia benchmarking: DAV, DailyMed, DDInter, RxNorm)
model_adjudication (v1 and v2 multi-specialist council consensus)
property_assurance (state machine mutation testing and invariant proofs)

interface_assumptions: services/api communicates with services/ml strictly through HTTP proxy (endpoints mounted at /v1/*) authenticated via X-ML-Internal-Key header.
services/ml maintains independent schema models in clara_ml.rag.store.schema.Base; no shared database foreign keys exist between API and ML services.
Persistent RAG requires PostgreSQL with pgvector and pg_trgm extensions; in development/CI without pgvector, RAG automatically degrades to InMemoryRetriever.
Model Gateway enforces DeepSeek-only generative routing by default; unofficial Gemini gateway is restricted to fast multimodal/OCR routes.
Synthesis v2 remains behind the feature flag SYNTHESIS_V2_ENABLED=false until clinical review passes.
rollback_steps: Discard untracked deliverables in artifacts/PH00/A04/ via `git clean -fd artifacts/PH00/A04/`.
